releaseNotes: ## [1.0.5] — Tester drop (2026-05-22)  **Build artefacts** - `CallNest-1.0.5.apk` — 21 MB - SHA-256: `884f961038c03107e14d515a109d40d09b0f5ed5aec1642a67e3b9d9bec14c81` - versionCode 7  ### Added - Capture and display carrier caller-ID names for unsaved numbers — a new `CallScreeningService` records the carrier-supplied name during the ring, and unsaved Calls rows surface it with a subtle \"Caller ID\" chip. - Save inquiries with the caller-ID name as the contact's first name — the existing `callNest-s1 +91… callNest` format becomes the last name, so the OS Contacts app shows `Rahul callNest-s1 +91… callNest` for an unknown \"Rahul\". - Added optional **Capture carrier caller-ID names** toggle in Settings → Privacy; OFF by default. Turning it on requests the system Call-Screening role; the capture is still best-effort on devices that route screening without the role.
